description: This file defines a fetch-based HTTP client with features like base URL handling, timeout, retries, and JSON response normalization. It exports a function to create an API client with convenience methods for HTTP verbs.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full URL from a base and a path, handling slashes.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified delay in milliseconds.

methods.name: isRetriable
methods.description: Determines if an error or status code is retriable.

methods.name: fetchWithTimeout
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with a timeout, aborting if exceeded.

methods.name: toJsonResponse
methods.description: Normalizes fetch response: parses JSON or text, attaches status and headers.
